paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 本文提出了结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一桥梁，揭示了状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间的深层理论联系 [S1.p2][S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。基于该框架，作者设计了一种新的 SSD 算法，利用半可分矩阵的分块分解，在训练和推理中兼顾线性复杂度与硬件效率 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S6.p4]。作者进一步提出了 Mamba-2 架构，其核心层是 Mamba 选择性 SSM 的改进版本，速度提升 2-8 倍，并在语言建模上保持与 Transformer 的竞争力 [abstract][S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。实验表明，Mamba-2 在困惑度和实际运行时间上均优于 Mamba 和 Transformer++，并在下游评估中匹配或超越同规模的开源 Transformer [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3][S9.F9]。

research_question.text: 本文旨在建立结构化 SSM 与注意力变体之间的丰富理论联系，从而将原本为 Transformer 开发的算法和系统优化迁移到 SSM，以构建比 Transformer 性能更好且随序列长度扩展更高效的基础模型 [S1.p2]。作者指出，SSM 的发展与社区改进 Transformer 的努力（如理论理解和硬件优化）显得脱节，导致 SSM 比 Transformer 更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度都难以像 Transformer 那样高效训练 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.

This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs, towards the goal of building foundation models that perform better than Transformers while scaling more efficiently in sequence length.

However, the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers, such as understanding them theoretically as well as optimizing them on modern hardware.

As a result, it is more difficult to understand and experiment with SSMs compared to Transformers, and it remains challenging to train SSMs as efficiently as Transformers from both an algorithmic and systems perspective.

method.text: 作者提出了结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一桥梁连接 SSM 与注意力变体 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。该框架表明 SSM 等价于半可分矩阵，并可将 SSM 的计算重新表述为结构化矩阵乘法算法 [S3.SS3.p2][S3.SS4.p1]。作者还推广了线性注意力，提出了结构化掩码注意力（SMA），并证明 SSM 与 SMA 存在大量交集且互为对偶，同时具有 SSM 式线性和注意力式二次形式 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。基于此，作者设计了 SSD 算法，利用半可分矩阵的分块分解，对角块用二次注意力模式计算，非对角块利用秩结构分解为更小的递归 [S6.p4]。

evidence.quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
Equation ( 3) directly establishes the link between state space models and the sequentially semiseparable representation, which in turn are equivalent to semiseparable matrices in general
it will allow us to reduce the problem of efficient computation of SSMs (and other sequence models) into efficient algorithms for structured matrix multiplication.
We connect SSMs and SMA, showing that they have a large intersection that are duals of each other, possessing both SSM-like linear and attention-like quadratic forms

Instead of computing the whole matrix in either recurrent or attention mode, we perform a block decomposition of the matrix. The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode, which can be efficiently done with matrix multiplications, while the off-diagonal blocks can be factored by the rank-structure of semiseparable matrices and reduced to a smaller recurrence.

experiments.text: 作者在合成关联召回任务（MQAR）上评估了 Mamba-2，该任务要求模型记忆多个键值关联 [S9.SS1.p1]。在语言建模方面，作者在 Pile 数据集上训练了从约 125M 到 2.7B 参数的模型，遵循 GPT3 规格和 Chinchilla 协议，并与 Mamba 和 Transformer++ 进行对比 [S9.SS2.p1][S9.SS2.SSS1.p2]。作者还进行了速度基准测试，将 SSD 算法与 Mamba 的扫描实现和 FlashAttention-2 进行比较 [S9.SS3.p1]。此外，作者对 Mamba-2 架构的块设计、多头结构和注意力核近似等设计选择进行了消融实验 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p1][S9.SS4.SSS2.p2][S9.SS4.SSS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: The multi-query associative recall (MQAR) task is a particular formulation of this task that requires the model to memorize multiple associations.
The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
Figure 9 shows scaling laws under the standard Chinchilla protocol, on models from $\approx 125M$ to $\approx 1.3B$ parameters.
We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2
Table 4 ablates these architecture changes to the block, which occur outside of the core SSM layer.
Table 5 ablates choices of the multi-head structure for the Mamba-2 architecture.
We ablate several variants of these suggested by previous works in Figure 12.

findings.text: SSD 算法比 Mamba 的优化选择性扫描实现快 2-8 倍，同时允许更大的循环状态尺寸，并在序列长度 2K 处与 FlashAttention-2 交叉，在 16K 处快 6 倍 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。在 MQAR 任务上，Mamba-2 在所有设置下表现良好，即使控制状态大小（N=16）也显著优于 Mamba-1，且增大状态尺寸（N=16 到 64 和 256）持续提升性能 [S9.SS1.p3]。在语言建模上，Mamba-2 在困惑度和实际运行时间上均帕累托优于 Mamba 和 Transformer++ [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。例如，在 Pile 上训练 300B token 的 2.7B 参数 Mamba-2 优于 Mamba-2.8B、Pythia-2.8B 甚至 Pythia-6.9B [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。

evidence.quote: A dedicated implementation of SSD is $2-8\times$ faster than the optimized selective scan implementation of Mamba, while simultaneously allowing for much larger recurrent state sizes
SSD is highly competitive with optimized implementations of softmax attention (FlashAttention-2), crossing over at sequence length 2K and 6 $\times$ faster at sequence length 16K.
While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings. Surprisingly, it is significantly better than Mamba-1 even when the state sizes are controlled ( $\mathtt{N}=16$).
increasing from $\mathtt{N}=16$ to $\mathtt{N}=64$ and $\mathtt{N}=256$ consistently improves performance on MQAR
finding that it Pareto dominates Mamba and Transformer++ in both perplexity and wall-clock time.
For example, Mamba-2 with 2.7B parameters trained on 300B tokens on the Pile outperforms Mamba-2.8B, Pythia-2.8B and even Pythia-6.9B trained on the same dataset.

limitations.text: 作者指出，SSD 相比 Mamba 仅在 A_t 的对角形式上更具限制性，以牺牲部分表达能力换取硬件效率提升 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。作者假设可能可以改进结构化矩阵算法以推广到一般对角 SSM 情形 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p2]。在 MQAR 任务上，Mamba-2 显著优于 Mamba-1 的原因尚不明确，作者表示这是未来工作需要探索的问题 [S9.SS1.p3]。此外，作者尝试的核近似方法未能超越简单的逐点非线性激活函数，但作者强调 SSD 与普通线性注意力的区别在于包含 1-半可分掩码，因此这些负面结果可能并不意外 [S9.SS4.SSS3.p4][S9.SS4.SSS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: Thus compared to Mamba, SSD differs only in a slightly more restrictive form of diagonal $A_{t}$, and trades off this expressivity for improved hardware efficiency (and ease of implementation).
We hypothesize that it may be possible to refine our structured matrix algorithms to improve to the general diagonal SSM case as well.
(We are not sure which aspect of the architecture is the predominant factor, which remains a question to explore in future work.)
Overall, Figure 12 and Figure 12 found that the kernel approximation methods we tried did not seem to improve over simple pointwise non-linear activation functions for $\psi$.

We emphasize however that SSD and vanilla linear attention differ in the inclusion of the 1-semiseparable mask $L$, while the various linear attention methods in the literature were derived to approximate softmax attention without this term; thus, our negative results may be not unexpected.
